claims.claim: The asset matches the requested fixture, dimensions, name, and part count.
claims.evidence: asset/asset.json declares kind=fixture. asset/model.urdf has one link base and one box named wall, size 0.02 x 0.40 x 0.20 m. readings.json collision_boxes[0] bounds are [-0.01,-0.20,0] to [0.01,0.20,0.20] m. joints, handles, and place_targets are empty, as requested.

claims.claim: Collision geometry exactly matches the visible wall.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf visual wall and collision wall both have box size 0.02 0.4 0.2, origin 0 0 0.1, and zero rotation. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png, and iso.png show a single plain rectangular wall. readings.json lists one collision box and no collision meshes; there is no extra or missing geometry.

claims.claim: Joint travel and moving-part support checks pass as inapplicable; there are no inter-link penetrations.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf contains only base and no joints. readings.json joints=[]; probes/01_contact.out reports joints={} and overlaps=[].

claims.claim: Handle grasp and pull checks pass as inapplicable.
claims.evidence: request.md specifies no handles; readings.json handles=[] and the URDF has no moving parts.

claims.claim: Place-target settling checks pass as inapplicable.
claims.evidence: request.md specifies no place targets; readings.json place_targets=[]. Objects are carried over this barrier rather than placed on it.

claims.claim: The fixed wall stays upright and stationary when 5 cm cubes contact both sides.
claims.evidence: probes/01_contact.py loads fixed=True and presses two 0.05 m cubes toward opposite faces with 2 N each for 60 frames, then releases for 60 frames. probes/01_contact.out records four 0.5 N wall contacts per cube. Initial, loaded, and released base positions are [0,0,0] with identity rotation. Loaded cube centres have x=+/-0.03489 m; released centres have x=+/-0.03500 m, confirming blocking at the wall faces. Wall bounds remain [-0.01,-0.2,0] to [0.01,0.2,0.2] m.

claims.claim: Free-standing rigid-object settling checks pass as inapplicable to this fixed fixture.
claims.evidence: request.md requires a fixture loaded fixed on a table, and asset/asset.json and readings.json declare fixture. Fixed-contact stability was tested in probes/01_contact.out.
